A noise texture used for convolution [S1].

The evidence explicitly states in the notes and the passage that the method uses an 'LIC texture' (Line Integral Convolution texture) and mentions that the method 'can represent finer details depending on the resolution of the noise texture employed.' Since LIC (Line Integral Convolution) is a technique that generates textures by convolving a noise field with a vector field, the claim that a 'noise texture used for convolution' is used is factually supported by the text describing the generation of the LIC texture.
supported

2.  **Probability Map:** A data set estimating the probability that a voxel lies within a nerve fibre structure [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the method uses 'two data sets to define the transfer functions,' one of which is 'information about the expected probability that a particular voxel lies within the nerve fibre structure which is estimated by the number of times the associated cell has been hit by field lines during the generation of the (LIC) texture.' This directly supports the claim that the probability map estimates the probability that a voxel lies within a nerve fibre structure.
